policy: Only genuinely structurally malformed records (unparseable JSON, missing required top-level field for the config, questions/answers length mismatch) may be excluded, and even then must be preserved in raw/ with an ID and reason recorded here. Records are never excluded for being hard, noisy, contradictory, incomplete, or producing an undefined metric.
reason_this_manifest_is_empty: A full (non-sampled) scan of all 701 records across all 5 HuggingFace configs found zero JSON parse failures, zero missing required fields, zero questions/answers length mismatches, zero null/empty question or answer elements, and zero duplicate IDs (see reports/raw_inventory.md). There was therefore nothing meeting the exclusion criteria to exclude. This manifest is empty because nothing qualified, not because exclusion was skipped or not considered.
